name: Motunui synthetic fuels plant (New Zealand Synfuels), Taranaki, New Zealand
description: 14,500 bpd of synthetic gasoline from Maui natural gas via methanol; the world's first natural-gas-to-gasoline plant, opened February 1985 (Methanex later closed the Taranaki units after 30+ years)

sources.note: DigitalRefining news, 21 Jul 2014 (first commercialised 1985 by New Zealand Synfuels, 14,500 bpd); MOTAT collection record (opened Feb 1985, Maui gas); read 2026-10-28
